implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures are gating events in M&A - they announce material shareholding changes and open the door to open offer obligations if threshold (typically 26% or above) is crossed; counsel should correlate the filing date with any subsequent open offer announcement and buyer's identity.

headline: Kotyark Industries Limited files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial share acquisition
sum: Kotyark Industries has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011 Reg. 31(4) following a substantial acquisition of shares. The filing signals crossing of a disclosure threshold but acquirer identity and consideration remain unreported in public sources.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, an acquirer crossing 5% shareholding in a listed company must disclose within two working days under Reg. 31(4). This disclosure for Kotyark Industries was filed to NSE on 22 Jun 2026. The identity of the acquirer, quantum of shares acquired, and consideration have not been disclosed in publicly indexed sources as of the search date; the full details lie in the actual PDF disclosure document filed with the exchange.
